title: Release notes configuration
description: Consumer configuration for the release-notes action, read from .github/giskard/release-notes.json.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor support.

github_repository.description: owner/repo used for compare URLs and GitHub issue enrichment. Defaults to GITHUB_REPOSITORY.

manifest_paths.description: Dependency manifests (pyproject.toml, package.json, pom.xml) diffed for the dependency table.

high_signal_prefixes.description: Path prefixes whose per-file diffs are prioritized in commit digests.

ignored_basenames.description: File basenames excluded from diff stats and digests. Defaults to ["uv.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml"].

file_diffs.description: Paths whose unified tag-range diff is embedded in the rendered notes.

ignored_path_prefixes.description: Path prefixes excluded from diff stats.

sections.description: Ordered output sections. When non-empty, only the listed sections are rendered. Omit to use summary, features, fixes, misc.

upgrade_rules.description: Deterministic rules that emit an upgrade note when matching paths change in the tag range.

model.description: Default giskard-llm model name, e.g. azure_ai/gpt-5.6-luna.

consolidation_effort.description: Reasoning effort override for per-commit consolidation.

synthesis_model.description: Model override for release notes synthesis.

synthesis_effort.description: Reasoning effort override for release notes synthesis.

llm_concurrency.description: Maximum parallel LLM calls during consolidation. Defaults to 10.

id.description: Section identifier. Built-ins: summary, features, fixes, misc, ux_frontend, api_backend, python_api, infra_deps, upgrade_notes, deps, appendix. Any other identifier creates a custom section.

title.description: Rendered heading. Defaults to the built-in title or the id.

description.description: Writing instructions for the LLM. Defaults to the built-in description.

paths.description: Exact paths that trigger the rule.

path_prefixes.description: Path prefixes that trigger the rule.

filename_keywords.description: Optional keywords; when set, a path_prefixes match also requires one keyword in the filename.
